# Vantorre Group

*Updated October 2, 2026 — Ruth Calloway*

* **Account:** Vantorre Group
* **Internal codes:** VTG (standard CRM/billing); VTRG (used in board decks—ticker-style)
* **Segment / Geo:** Diversified industrial manufacturer, Northeast
* **Sites on Pemberline Dock:** Hartford and Albany plants
* **Corporate structure:** Parent of Vantorre Mobility (tracked as a separate account—do not roll up their yard traffic here)
* **Primary Contact:** Mateo Quiroga, Head of Procurement. (Tough on paper, hates Friday afternoon calls, prefers text if a site is down.)
* **Footprint:** 280 seats
* **Current Account Owner:** Gideon Sato (since May 4, 2026)
* **Previous Account Owner:** Nadia Fennimore (until May 4, 2026)

### Short History & Ops Notes

Nadia Fennimore ran this until the spring shuffle on May 4, 2026, when Gideon Sato took over. Handover was mostly smooth except for that lingering EDI parser bug at the Albany facility (Ticket #4418—flatbed check-ins at Gate 4 were duplicating if the driver hit the kiosk screen twice). Support patched it in July. 

Hartford plant uses Pemberline Dock heavily for raw steel coil deliveries on the morning shift—Doors 1 through 6 only, overhead crane bay. Albany is mostly outbound palletized machinery and custom stamping runs. Mateo Quiroga asked Gideon last month for a custom export of the `Carrier_Dwell_Summary_v2` report because their Hartford third-shift supervisor, Kowalski, still prints paper manifests before the 5:00 AM shift change. Need to get them off the spreadsheets before winter weather hits the Northeast corrider and backs up the yard.
